mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at a clear sky and 70 degrees at Verona Community Park, with a first quarter moon overhead.

In city news, VHAT remains your go-to source for Verona government meetings and community programming. Also, a reminder to follow local parking ordinances, which restrict how you store recreational vehicles and trailers on your property.
There is plenty to do in town this week. You can catch trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Louie on Tuesday, attend the Farmer's Market on Wednesday, or enjoy Concerts in the Park this Thursday.
On July 13, Verona police responded to a report of a vehicle stuck on a large rock, which resulted in the driver being arrested for a first offense of operating while intoxicated.
Today's flavor is the delightful Chocolate Caramel Twist. If you miss it, tomorrow features Mint Explosion. Culver's is currently closed but will open its doors to serve you starting at 10 AM.
